record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare HURRICANE (passive NONE in the catalog; regional flag and isInRegion are not part of the ability). The strategy is shared; the units differ in stars and stats. Other units are not covered.
record.summary: Line attack: every enemy standing on a supercover line from the caster through the cast target to the far board edge is first paralysed (requested 3000 ms) and then takes the same raw SPECIAL damage (25/50/100 by the caster's stars; 200 is the 4-star value and fallback, not reachable by the three listed units). Allies on the line and empty cells are skipped. Damage is a flat table value (no atk scaling) and goes through the normal AP / crit / SPE_DEF pipeline for each victim separately.

targeting.who: all enemy entities on the cells of the line defined by the caster's position and the cast target's position (the target itself is on the line)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not traced beyond the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's cell through the target's cell, extended to a point 12 cells away along the angle (rounded) and clipped to the board; every touched cell counts, diagonal crossings included; the caster's own cell is the first cell and is skipped by the team check

effects.scaling: requested amount per victim = the table value (no atk scaling). In handleSpecialDamage for each victim: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x2 if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed by the first victim, so later victims on the line do not get it); x1.2 if either side has STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT; the crit factor only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so it needs ABILITY_CRIT), reduced to 0 for a Rocky Helmet victim and by 0.1 per Black Augurite of the victim's player (floor 0); the crit flag is the same for every victim
effects.resolution: then PokemonState.handleDamage per victim: x2 if the caster is enraged, attacker/target field and weather multipliers (read as a list), SPE_DEF division damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef) (speDef halved while the victim has armorReduction), Poke Doll / Guts-Sturdy-Defiant-Coaching / Wonder Guard reductions, ceil with a minimum of 1; a shield absorbs first. Blocked (takenDamage 0) for a victim with protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce also queues a reflected hit unless the caster holds Protective Pads), or at 0 hp / resurrecting; a Cover Band ally adjacent to a victim that would die takes that hit instead. takenDamage is returned but discarded. Requested = table value; applied = what is left after these steps for each victim.

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit: HURRICANE does not pass apBoost, which defaults to false in triggerParalysis
statusEffects.applicationOrder: for each enemy cell, paralysis first and then the damage; a victim that dies from the hit has already been paralysed
statusEffects.guards: not applied if the victim's status has runeProtect or the victim has the IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS effect. When applied: STORM weather multiplies the duration by 1.3, then by (1 - 0.2 x Electric Quartz count of the victim's player); then applyStatusDurationReductions with the VICTIM as pkm (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, each Math.round, then Odd Keystone -10% each of the victim's player). The paralysis flag is set before the duration check; the remaining time is replaced only by a longer duration. A Cheri Berry holder eats the berry right after the application. Requested 3000 ms; applied duration is that value after the modifiers above, rounded. Paralysis is applied before and independently of handleSpecialDamage, so a protected or magic-bouncing victim is still paralysed (the blocking checks live inside the damage function).
statusEffects.combatEffect: while paralysed, speed is halved in the attack cooldown (AttackingState.update), the attack duration calculation and the movement-speed factor. Other readers of status.paralysis exist (Bug Buzz, Force Palm, Zing Zap, Mach / synergy code); they were not traced here.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (200, also the fallback) is not reachable by the three units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). maxPP 100 and range 2 for all three. The paralysis duration (3000) does not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: Which enemies are hit depends on the caster and target coordinates (angle to the target, rounded end point, supercover cells); enemies behind the target on the same line are hit as well, enemies beside it are not. An ally on the line is skipped but does not block the line.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. A repeated cast re-applies paralysis (remaining time replaced only by a longer duration) and damage.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 25/50/100 per enemy on the line, paralysis 3000 ms. Applied per victim: damage x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor] [x DOUBLE_DAMAGE on the first victim only / strange-steam / enraged / field / weather], then SPE_DEF division, ceil, at least 1, other reductions, shield first; paralysis skipped under Rune Protect or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS, otherwise 3000 ms x storm factor, then the victim-side duration reductions (rounded).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Field, weather and Poke Doll / Guts-type multipliers in handleDamage were read as a list (lines 455-595), not each traced
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence): only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution before the call: only the damage-side multiplier in handleSpecialDamage was read
The order in which the line cells are visited (the supercover loop was read; its effect on DOUBLE_DAMAGE consumption and on kill order was not simulated)
Positions of units at the instant of the cast and whether entities can occupy the same cell: only cell.value of the board array is read
unresolved: Whether any item or synergy effect other than those listed changes HURRICANE damage or paralysis
Other readers of status.paralysis were not traced beyond the three speed formulas
No routing uncertainty was recorded for HURRICANE in the queue; no other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue
